nodes.title: Direct Debit
nodes.summary: This section introduces the Direct Debit API, enabling automated debits from an account up to a pre-set amount over a defined timeframe without requiring further approval.

nodes.title: Direct Debit Flow
nodes.summary: This section explains the direct debit service flow, involving creating a mandate, account holder approval, and then debiting the account.

nodes.title: Get Bank List
nodes.summary: This endpoint retrieves a dynamic list of banks for which the Direct Debit service is available, allowing mandates to be created only for the banks returned.

nodes.title: Sample BankList Response
nodes.summary: This section provides a sample JSON response illustrating the structure and data returned by the Get Bank List endpoint.

nodes.title: Create Mandate
nodes.summary: This endpoint allows users to create a new mandate for a customer's account.

nodes.title: Parameters
nodes.summary: This section details the various parameters required to create a mandate, including type, amount, account details, and customer information.

nodes.title: Responses
nodes.summary: This section outlines the possible responses for the Create Mandate endpoint, including successful mandate creation and various error cases.

nodes.title: Sample Request
nodes.summary: This section provides a sample JSON payload illustrating how to structure a request to the Create Mandate endpoint.

nodes.title: Webhook Notification For Mandate Creation
nodes.summary: This section illustrates the webhook notification received upon mandate creation, detailing its status and relevant information.

nodes.title: Webhook Notification for Approved Mandate
nodes.summary: This section shows the webhook notification received when a mandate becomes approved and ready for debiting.

nodes.title: Debit Mandate
nodes.summary: This endpoint allows for debiting an account after a mandate has been successfully created and approved.

nodes.title: Parameters
nodes.summary: This section lists the parameters required for debiting an account using an existing mandate, such as amount, mandate ID, and transaction reference.

nodes.title: Responses
nodes.summary: This section details the possible responses for the Debit Mandate endpoint, including successful debits and errors like 'Mandate Not Ready' or 'Daily Limit Reached'.

nodes.title: Sample Request
nodes.summary: This section provides a sample JSON payload for initiating a debit operation using an existing mandate.

nodes.title: Webhook Notification
nodes.summary: This section illustrates the webhook notification received upon a successful debit transaction from a mandated account.

nodes.title: Cancel Mandate
nodes.summary: This endpoint enables the cancellation of one or more existing mandates on an account.

nodes.title: Parameters
nodes.summary: This section describes the `mandateIds` parameter, which accepts a single or multiple mandate IDs for cancellation.

nodes.title: Responses
nodes.summary: This section details the possible responses for the Cancel Mandate endpoint, indicating successful cancellations or reasons for failure.

nodes.title: Sample Request
nodes.summary: This section provides a sample JSON payload demonstrating how to request the cancellation of multiple mandates.

nodes.title: Get Mandate By Ref
nodes.summary: This endpoint retrieves the detailed information of a specific mandate using its transaction reference.

nodes.title: Parameters
nodes.summary: This section indicates that the mandate reference is passed as a path parameter in the URL for this endpoint.

nodes.title: Responses
nodes.summary: This section outlines the possible responses for the Get Mandate By Ref endpoint, including detailed mandate information or various error messages.

nodes.title: Go Live
nodes.summary: This section provides instructions on how to transition from the sandbox environment to the live production environment.
